title: Road-trip towns 1: New Jersey to Denver
prompt: An isometric view from the high three-quarter camera of a Minecraft-Dungeons-like game, everything built from chunky blocks with hand-painted pixel textures, a long American highway running from right to left across the picture, small blocky heroes (Percy, Annabeth and Grover) walking along the shoulder for scale. Four town scenes in a two-by-two grid: the New Jersey Turnpike with a Greyhound bus station, a truck stop and a burning wrecked bus blocking the road; Aunty Em's Garden Gnome Emporium on a back road, a warehouse surrounded by stone statues of frightened people and rows of gnomes; St. Louis with the silver Gateway Arch on the riverfront and a lift bridge over the brown Mississippi; Denver with snowy mountains behind a rusting abandoned water park full of slides. 3D game art in the blocky voxel style of Minecraft Dungeons: characters built from cubes, with a large cube head whose face is simple pixel art (about 8 × 8 pixels: pixel eyes, a pixel mouth, hair drawn as pixels and as a few blocky tufts), a boxy torso, square arms and legs, crisp pixel-art textures (about 16 pixels per block) with simple shading, chunky readable silhouettes; warm cinematic lighting, soft ambient occlusion and glowing magic effects. Costume colours and details follow the Camp Half-Blood cartoon concept art. Palette: camp orange #f28c28, sea teal #0f6f73, deep navy #10233d, jade #2e8b6e, coral #e8664a, bronze gold #c9963a, lightning yellow #ffd84a, parchment cream #f4ead5, vase black #17130f and owl grey #8c96a3. No lettering, logos, captions or watermark.
